name: Voice AI Checker
tagline: Free AI voice detector for short clips—flags AI-generated, cloned, or deepfake speech.
description: Voice AI Checker is a free online AI voice detector for short speech samples. Upload a voice note, record a quick sample, or check a clip before you trust it. The tool returns a plain risk signal—likely AI, likely human, or unclear—powered by Modulate's Velma-2 Synthetic Voice Detection API. Guest users can analyze up to 15 seconds with 1 free check per day. Google sign-in raises that to 30 seconds and 3 free checks per day. Need more? A one-time $4.99 pack adds 20 credits, or Pro adds 50 checks each UTC month for $9.90. Best results come from clean, single-speaker speech of about 10–30 seconds. Treat results as a first-pass screening signal, not forensic proof.
